deadline.value: Cal State Apply is due December 1, 2026. Transcripts and the program application are due December 15, 2026.

gre_general.value: The chemistry PhD does not require the GRE General.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required for applications to our graduate degree programs.

gre_subject.value: The chemistry PhD does not require a GRE Subject test either.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE is not required for applications to our graduate degree programs.

supervisor.value: The page asks for at least one letter from a research mentor, but it does not say a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Most admitted PhD students get a teaching or research assistantship, depending on available funding.
funding.quote: Most admitted Ph.D. students receive teaching or research assistantships, depending on available funding.

entry_route.value: The chemistry page does not say whether a bachelor's degree alone is enough.

notes: Joint PhD with UC San Diego (official doctoral list). The page also lists a UC San Diego component deadline in December 2026.
